failure_patterns.pattern: quantifier_miss: Broadened a fixed 2-color claim to all finite colorings and upgraded existence for some regularity exponent to every exponent.

rejected_edits.content: For “strongest valid” and equivalence questions, split each option into separate claims and verify every clause independently. One unsupported modifier invalidates the option; equivalence requires both implications under the stated hypotheses.
For quantitative estimates, check the domain of each norm and the stated dependencies of constants literally; local and global bounds are not interchangeable.
